title: Zscaler-Terraformer: importing existing configuration into HCL

prose.text: {{shared.terraform:terraformer-offered|ref}} Zscaler-Terraformer is a separate tool from the providers; its repository is vendored here but is not a registered source, so what is known about its output is recorded as open questions.

Whether its generated HCL can be applied without repair is open {{gap:generated-hcl-review}}; which ZTC resources it covers is a separate open question in [[cloud-connector.terraform.coverage:terraformer-ztc-inventory]]. Whether the DLP rule excluded users and groups fix holds, and whether name lookups stay correct when IDs collide, are open {{gap:dlp-excluded-names}} and {{gap:name-registry-collisions}}.

generated-hcl-review.title: Whether Terraformer output needs manual repair before apply
generated-hcl-review.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Terraformer "converts existing ZIA, ZPA, and a bounded ZTC resource set into Terraform HCL and import commands", and "its own documentation warns that generated HCL is not guaranteed to be perfect and may need manual repair"; "check --supported-resources=<product> before assuming a provider resource is covered" (vendor/zscaler-terraformer/README.md). The Terraformer repository is vendored but not a registered source.

dlp-excluded-names.title: Terraformer v2.1.22 DLP excluded_users and excluded_groups mapping
dlp-excluded-names.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Terraformer v2.1.22 fixes the prior ZIA DLP nested-attribute spelling/HCL-shape defect: its mapping and special-block list now use excluded_users and excluded_groups, matching the current ZIA provider schema" (vendor/zscaler-terraformer CHANGELOG and terraformutils). Terraformer is not a registered source.

name-registry-collisions.title: Terraformer name lookups when users and groups share an ID
name-registry-collisions.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "RegisterNestedIDNames() builds its lookup from snake-case mapping names such as excluded_users and excluded_groups, while HCL generation reads the lower-camel API keys excludedUsers and excludedGroups ... duplicate names can still generate multiple by-name lookups, and a numeric ID reused by a user and group can leak one type's name into the other. The final replacement pass is also keyed by ID alone, so one of two type-specific references sharing an ID can remain raw." Inspect generated resource blocks and datasource.tf before applying. Terraformer is not a registered source.
